d75b848f3e01cad6.name: brainstrike_askUser
d75b848f3e01cad6.description: Ask the user a clarifying question and WAIT for their answer (the run pauses). Provide options for a structured choice (selectionMode multi_select allows several), or omit options for a free-text question

options.description:
Optional choices. Omit for a free-text question.
constraints: minimum length 1, maximum length 10

description.description:
Optional context for the option (does not change the answer value).
constraints: maximum length 1000

label.description:
Option label; the value returned when chosen.
constraints: minimum length 1, maximum length 500

question.description:
The clear, specific question to ask the user.
constraints: minimum length 1, maximum length 2000

selectionMode.description: How many options the user may pick. Requires options; defaults to single_select.

d75b848f3e01cad6.name: brainstrike_submitPlan
d75b848f3e01cad6.description: Submit a structured implementation plan (title, overview, ordered steps, optional risks/verification) for the user to Approve or Reject. The run PAUSES until they respond; rejection feedback is returned so you can revise and resubmit

overview.description:
One or two paragraphs summarizing the plan and its goal.
constraints: minimum length 1, maximum length 4000

risks.description:
Optional risks, tradeoffs, or things that could go wrong.
constraints: maximum length 4000

steps.description:
Ordered implementation steps.
constraints: minimum length 1, maximum length 30

detail.description:
Optional elaboration of the step (what/why/how).
constraints: maximum length 2000

title.description:
Short imperative step title.
constraints: minimum length 1, maximum length 500

Short title for the plan.
constraints: minimum length 1, maximum length 300

verification.description:
Optional how-to-verify: tests, checks, or acceptance criteria.
constraints: maximum length 4000

d75b848f3e01cad6.name: brainstrike_readWorkspaceFile
d75b848f3e01cad6.description: Read a file from a chosen open workspace root as bounded, line-numbered pages with a short thread-scoped continuation handle. For later pages pass only cursor (and optional maxChars); omit path/root/startLine/endLine

cursor.description: Short nextCursor handle from the previous page. Pass it unchanged with optional maxChars and omit every other field

anyOf.description: constraints: input must match this regex ^rfh_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{22}$

endLine.description: Last 1-based line; omit with cursor unless replaying the original value unchanged

anyOf.description: constraints: lower than or equal to 50000, greater than 0

path.description: Workspace-relative file path; required only when starting a new read

root.description: Open-folder name/id. Omit for this thread's primary folder; an explicit root always wins.

startLine.description: First 1-based line; omit with cursor unless replaying the original value unchanged

d75b848f3e01cad6.name: brainstrike_writeWorkspaceFile
d75b848f3e01cad6.description: Write or create a UTF-8 file in a chosen open workspace root (overwrites existing content; refuses if the file changed on disk since you last read it — re-read and retry; workspace-scoped, requires approval). bytesWritten confirms it landed; skip re-reading

content.description:
Full UTF-8 content (up to ~2 MB); overwrites an existing file
constraints: maximum length 8000000

path.description:
Workspace-relative path; creates missing parent directories
constraints: minimum length 1

root.description: Open-folder name/id. Omit for this thread's primary folder; an explicit root always wins.

d75b848f3e01cad6.name: brainstrike_stringReplaceWorkspaceFile
d75b848f3e01cad6.description: Surgically edit a file in a chosen open workspace root by replacing one oldStr block with newStr (fuzzy-matched; refuses ambiguous matches; refuses if the file changed on disk since you last read it — re-read and retry; workspace-scoped, requires approval). matchType "exact" confirms verbatim placement; other matchTypes are fuzzy — re-read for precision

newStr.description:
Replacement text; empty deletes the matched block
constraints: maximum length 8000000

oldStr.description:
Existing text block. Use whole lines and enough context to identify one location; ambiguous matches are refused.
constraints: minimum length 1, maximum length 8000000

path.description:
Existing workspace-relative file path
constraints: minimum length 1

root.description: Open-folder name/id. Omit for this thread's primary folder; an explicit root always wins.

d75b848f3e01cad6.name: brainstrike_globWorkspace
d75b848f3e01cad6.description: Enumerate workspace files whose path matches a glob (e.g. **/*.test.ts, src/**/*.tsx). One path per result line, prefixed with its root name when several folders are open. Excludes .git, build output, and gitignored paths by default; pass includeIgnored to see them; read-only

includeIgnored.description: Include excluded paths: build output, generated artifacts, and gitignored files such as coverage/ or .env* (default false)

limit.description:
Match cap (default 200)
constraints: lower than or equal to 1000, greater than 0

offset.description:
Pagination offset
constraints: greater than or equal to 0, lower than or equal to 100000

pattern.description:
Workspace-relative glob; bare patterns match at any depth
constraints: minimum length 1, maximum length 500

root.description: Open-folder name/id. Omit to search all of this thread's folders. Results include their root.

d75b848f3e01cad6.name: brainstrike_readToolOutputArtifact
d75b848f3e01cad6.description: Page/grep; never alter or recreate the cursor.

cursor.description:
Prior cursor; copy byte-for-byte, never edit or recreate it.
constraints: minimum length 1, maximum length 2048

maxBytes.description: constraints: greater than or equal to 4, lower than or equal to 8000

d75b848f3e01cad6.name: updateWorkingMemory
d75b848f3e01cad6.description: Update the working memory with new information. Any data not included will be overwritten. Always pass data as string to the memory field. Never pass an object.

memory.description: The Markdown formatted working memory content to store. This MUST be a string. Never pass an object.

d75b848f3e01cad6.name: agent-explore
d75b848f3e01cad6.description: Delegate broad, RAG-native codebase exploration: semantic + exact search across the workspace, then read the most relevant files. Use when a question needs surveying many files before answering. Returns reported findings to verify, not established fact. Read-only leaf: cannot spawn child agents. For a hierarchy, choose an available worker-mode supervisor instead; do not assign onward delegation to this persona. Runs at most 100 steps, one of which is reserved for its summary — scope the task to that budget and split anything larger across several delegations. The root turn permits at most 3 descendant levels, 200 invocations, 6 active work operations, 32768 output tokens per child and 6553600 across descendants.

_background.description: Optional: override how this delegation executes. Omit it in most cases.

disposition.description: Run this delegation inline (foreground) or in the background (deferred).

enabled.description: false runs this delegation in the foreground.

d75b848f3e01cad6.name: agent-analyze
d75b848f3e01cad6.description: Delegate focused analysis that combines reading workspace files with external web research. Use when a question needs both in-repo reading and up-to-date external context. Returns reported findings to verify, not established fact. Read-only leaf: cannot spawn child agents. For a hierarchy, choose an available worker-mode supervisor instead; do not assign onward delegation to this persona. Runs at most 100 steps, one of which is reserved for its summary — scope the task to that budget and split anything larger across several delegations. The root turn permits at most 3 descendant levels, 200 invocations, 6 active work operations, 32768 output tokens per child and 6553600 across descendants.

_background.description: Optional: override how this delegation executes. Omit it in most cases.

disposition.description: Run this delegation inline (foreground) or in the background (deferred).

enabled.description: false runs this delegation in the foreground.

d75b848f3e01cad6.name: agent-worker
d75b848f3e01cad6.description: Delegate an authorized deliverable: implement changes, create artifacts, execute checks, or use eligible integrations. Returns a concise result with evidence and output paths. Can supervise child agents within the remaining depth budget. For hierarchical research, use workers as supervisors and read-only Explorers as leaves; keep each task within the user-authorized scope. Runs at most 100 steps, one of which is reserved for its summary — scope the task to that budget and split anything larger across several delegations. The root turn permits at most 3 descendant levels, 200 invocations, 6 active work operations, 32768 output tokens per child and 6553600 across descendants.

_background.description: Optional: override how this delegation executes. Omit it in most cases.

disposition.description: Run this delegation inline (foreground) or in the background (deferred).

enabled.description: false runs this delegation in the foreground.

d75b848f3e01cad6.name: list_available_tools
d75b848f3e01cad6.description: List eligible deferred tools, including MCP tools, without loading their schemas. Use for questions about what tools are available. Filter by name prefix (for example linear). Follow nextOffset until null for the complete inventory. To use a listed tool, call load_tool with its exact name first.

offset.description:
Start at 0; use nextOffset for subsequent pages with the same prefix.
constraints: greater than or equal to 0

prefix.description:
Case-insensitive tool name prefix.
constraints: minimum length 1, maximum length 128

d75b848f3e01cad6.name: load_tool
d75b848f3e01cad6.description: Load one or more tools into your context. Call this after finding tools with search_tools. Once loaded, tools will be available for use. Pass a single toolName or an array of toolNames to load multiple tools at once.

toolName.description: The exact name of a tool to load (from search results)

toolNames.description: Array of exact tool names to load in one call (from search results)

d75b848f3e01cad6.name: search_tools
d75b848f3e01cad6.description: Search deferred capabilities this run: canvas documents, task lists, file delete/rename, directory listings, symbol and LSP inspection, including MCP tools, by keyword. Returns at most 3 ranked matches, not a complete inventory, and does not load them: call load_tool with the exact name(s) to use a match. If you already know a tool's exact name, call load_tool directly instead of searching. For the full inventory use list_available_tools.
